backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all backend data types, state maps, and access-control logic for a water delivery management system with roles (admin, staff, delivery, distributor). Includes user/store/order/QR/GPS/blob management and mixin-based authorization and storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels, covering invoice generation, delivery assignment flow, and QR scan flow fixes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key fixes applied to each component, page, hook, and context in the React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, sidebar, chart, and semantic UI colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vitalist Water React app, setting the page title, favicon, and mounting the root div with the main TSX module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that wraps the app in QueryClient and AuthProvider, handles role-based page routing via a string-keyed switch, and lazy-loads all page components with an ErrorBoundary.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/StatCa: Reusable dashboard stat card component displaying a label, count, icon, and optional trend text with color-coded styling via a predefined color map.
frontend/src/components/delivery/EmptyTr: A dialog component that allows users to select and upload an empty truck image for a given order, showing upload progress, success, and error states.
frontend/src/components/delivery/ImageMo: A dialog component that displays a full-size image with a zoom toggle, or a placeholder message if no image URL is provided.
frontend/src/components/distributor/Barc: A QR/barcode scanning step component that activates the device camera via a custom hook, decodes scan results, and passes the scanned value to a callback.
frontend/src/components/distributor/Dist: A multi-step dialog for distributors to confirm a delivery by scanning an order QR code, uploading loaded and unloaded truck images, and submitting the confirmation.
frontend/src/components/distributor/Imag: A form step component for uploading two truck images (loaded and unloaded) with preview and clear functionality, converting files to Uint8Array before calling the completion callback.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class-based ErrorBoundary component that catches unhandled render errors and displays a branded error screen with a reload button.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppSideba: A role-based sidebar navigation component that renders different nav items for admin, staff, delivery, and distributor roles, along with user info and a logout button.
frontend/src/components/layout/Layout.ts: Main app layout component with a collapsible sidebar, top header bar showing user info and logout, and a main content area with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/map/SatelliteMap: Leaflet-based satellite map component that lazily loads Leaflet from CDN, renders Esri World Imagery tiles with optional labels, and supports custom markers and click handlers.
frontend/src/components/orders/InvoiceMo: Dialog modal that fetches order and store data, then renders an InvoiceView for a given order ID, with loading skeletons and error/not-found states.
frontend/src/components/orders/InvoiceVi: Printable invoice layout component displaying order details, store billing/shipping info, line-item totals with 18% GST, and a QR code generated from the order ID.
frontend/src/components/orders/QRPrintVi: Component that displays and prints a QR code for a given order, using a generated QR image URL with a print-specific CSS override to isolate the printable area.
frontend/src/components/orders/StatusBad: Small badge component that renders an order status with a color class and icon derived from utility functions.
frontend/src/components/orders/WorkflowS: Visual stepper component showing order workflow progress through predefined stages, with both compact (text) and full (step-circle) display modes.
frontend/src/components/qr/QRCodeDisplay: Renders a QR code image for an order ID at a configurable size, with fallback UI for missing IDs or image load errors.
frontend/src/components/qr/QRScanModal.t: A modal dialog component that activates the device camera to scan QR codes, handles camera permissions/errors, and calls a callback with the scanned value on success.
frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: Provides an authentication context with login/logout functionality backed by a canister actor, persisting session data in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor instance using React Query, initializing it with the current Internet Identity and an admin token from URL params.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout state and the current identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend data operations including orders, stores, users, and distributor deliveries, with role mapping utilities.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind CSS layers, CSS custom properties for light/dark themes (colors, sidebar, status badges), and reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/DeliveryVerific: Admin page that lists delivery verification records with truck images (loaded, unloaded, empty) and store location maps, using Leaflet for geolocation display and dialogs for full-size image previews.
frontend/src/pages/admin/DistributorDeli: Admin page for managing distributor deliveries with full CRUD operations, including a form dialog for creating/editing deliveries (truck number, driver info, estimated time) and a confirmation dialog for deletions.
frontend/src/pages/admin/LiveTrackingPag: Admin page that displays a Leaflet map with real-time truck delivery locations, polling the backend every 30 seconds and rendering markers for active 'Out for Delivery' or 'Dispatched' orders.
frontend/src/pages/admin/OrderManagement: Admin page for viewing, filtering, approving, and assigning delivery personnel to orders, with support for invoice modals and QR code printing.
frontend/src/pages/admin/QRManagementPag: Admin page that lists all orders with generated QR codes, showing stats for total, active, and completed QR codes along with a searchable grid of QR code displays.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ReportsPage.tsx: Admin analytics page that computes and displays order statistics (today, week, month, total), top stores by order count, and a status breakdown with bar charts derived from order data.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StoreManagement: Admin page for managing stores with full CRUD operations, including a form dialog with satellite map integration for selecting store coordinates and a delete confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: Admin page for managing users with CRUD operations, supporting role assignment (admin, staff, delivery, distributor) via a dialog form and delete confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin/staff dashboard page that displays stat cards (orders today, active deliveries, etc.) and a recent orders table, fetching data via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/delivery/DeliveryDash: Dashboard for delivery users showing assigned orders, supporting QR code scanning to update order status (dispatch/deliver) and GPS location tracking.
frontend/src/pages/distributor/Distribut: Dashboard for distributor users displaying their assigned orders and pending delivery confirmations, with a workflow dialog for processing confirmations.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with email/password form, show/hide password toggle, and error handling that calls the AuthContext login function.
frontend/src/pages/ScanPage.tsx: QR scanner page that opens a camera modal, decodes scanned QR codes to order IDs, and calls a mutation to advance the order's workflow status.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings page showing the current user's account info (name, email, role) and system info, with a sign-out button.
frontend/src/pages/staff/OrderCreationPa: Staff page for creating new orders by selecting a store, quantity, and rate, and for scanning QR codes to update approved order statuses.
frontend/src/utils/geoUtils.ts: Utility functions for geolocation including Haversine distance calculation, distance formatting, current position retrieval, and Google Maps URL generation.
frontend/src/utils/imageUtils.ts: Utility functions for converting images between Uint8Array, base64 data URLs, and File types using FileReader and btoa/atob.
frontend/src/utils/orderUtils.ts: Defines order workflow stages, status color/icon helpers, lock checks, status transition validation, and notes/meta parsing utilities for the order management system.
frontend/src/utils/qrGenerator.ts: Provides functions to encode order IDs into a 'VITALIST:' + base64 format and generate QR code image URLs via the goqr.me API.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both standard and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom font families, extended color palettes (ocean, aqua, and semantic tokens using oklch), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project state including known issues (QR scan flow, invoice generation, delivery panel assignment) and feature fix requests with requirement IDs for the current build cycle.
